description: Returns how a receiver does against man vs zone coverage and against each coverage shell (Cover 1, 2, 3, 4, ...): targets, catch rate, yards and EPA per target, and his share of targets in each. Coverage splits are the 2025 season (nflverse has no 2026 coverage file yet). It also returns 2026 season-to-date splits against the blitz and on play action, contested catch rate and drops (FTN charting via nflverse). Splits under 15 targets are flagged small_sample. Use it for "how does he do against man vs zone?". Players with at least 10 targets. No slot/wide alignment data. Basic plan and above.

player_id.description: GridIron player id, "First Last#POS", matched case-insensitively. Defenses are "Team Name#DST". Unsure of the id? Call search_players first.
player_id.title: Player Id

name: get_coverage_splits

coverage.description: 2025 season: targets_total and per-split lines for man, zone and each coverage shell (e.g. COVER_3): targets, receptions, yards, tds, air_yards, epa, ints, catch_rate, yards_per_target, epa_per_target, share_of_targets, and small_sample (true under 15 targets).

error.description: Present only when the call failed: what went wrong.

gsis_id.description: NFL GSIS id the charting data is keyed on.

pressure.description: 2026 season to date: vs_blitz, no_blitz, play_action and no_play_action lines (same fields), contested_catch_rate and drops.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure reason, e.g. basic_required or pro_required.

required_plan.description: The plan that unlocks this data: basic or pro.
